safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: No mention of neck stiffness (negative or positive) in Generated.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: In an acute/severe headache presentation, documenting absence of neck stiffness is an important red-flag screen for meningitis/subarachnoid hemorrhage; omission can lead to under-recognition of a potentially life-threatening condition if later clinicians rely on the note.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: No mention of fever (negative or positive) in Generated.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Fever is a key red-flag symptom in headache evaluation (infection/meningitis, systemic illness). Omitting a documented lack of fever can impair risk stratification and downstream triage decisions.
